text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Everything I run for is for the sake of my faves...!
To gaze upon a horse girl's divine face from this close...
What a blessing~!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"However, touching is strictly forbidden!
We must never forget where to draw the line... as otaku!"

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
